description: Source file implementing error handling functions for network errors, including error string conversions, error classification, and mapping file errors to network errors.

methods.name: ErrorToString
methods.description: Converts an error code to its string representation with namespace prefix.

methods.name: ExtendedErrorToString
methods.description: Returns a string for an error, including extended error code for specific errors.

methods.name: ErrorToShortString
methods.description: Returns a short string for an error code.

methods.name: IsCertificateError
methods.description: Checks if an error code is a certificate error.

methods.name: IsClientCertificateError
methods.description: Checks if an error code is a client certificate error.

methods.name: IsHostnameResolutionError
methods.description: Checks if an error code is a hostname resolution error.

methods.name: IsRequestBlockedError
methods.description: Checks if an error code indicates a blocked request.

methods.name: FileErrorToNetError
methods.description: Maps a file error to a network error code.
